citations.assessment: The Maavar Yabbok parallel supplies the almost identical story, naming Rav Yosef as the son whom his father tells to notify Chaggai. Exact Tziyyoni edition remains uncollated.

notes.text: The Yerushalmi and Kohelet give the rulings and order for lashes. The separately identified Maavar Yabbok parallel names the son Rav Yosef and makes his father the speaker. Keep Tziyyoni’s own uncollated wording separate.
